title: The Lord's Supper, Betrayal, and Arrest

questions.question: While Jesus was at Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, what did a woman break and pour over His head?
options: An alabaster flask of ointment of pure nard, very costly
A golden jar holding holy anointing oil
A clay pot of frankincense and myrrh
A skin of the finest red wine from Cana
questions.correctAnswer: An alabaster flask of ointment of pure nard, very costly
questions.explanation: Mark 14:3 (ESV): "...a woman came with an alabaster flask of ointment of pure nard, very costly, and she broke the flask and poured it over his head."

questions.question: Why were some people indignant about the woman pouring the ointment on Jesus?
options: "For this ointment could have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor."
"She interrupted the Passover meal to perform this."
"She was known to be a terrible sinner within the city."
"The strong smell of the ointment was offensive to them."
questions.correctAnswer: "For this ointment could have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor."
questions.explanation: Mark 14:5 (ESV): "For this ointment could have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor. And they scolded her."

questions.question: What did Jesus say the woman had done beforehand by anointing His body?
options: She has anointed my body beforehand for burial
She has crowned me as the true King of Israel
She has cleansed my body of all earthly dirt
She has prophesied my resurrection
questions.correctAnswer: She has anointed my body beforehand for burial
questions.explanation: Mark 14:8 (ESV): "She has done what she could; she has anointed my body beforehand for burial."

questions.question: Who went to the chief priests in order to betray Jesus to them, promising him money?
options: Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve
Peter, the fisherman
Simon the Zealot
Caiaphas the younger brother
questions.correctAnswer: Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve
questions.explanation: Mark 14:10-11 (ESV): "Then Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went to the chief priests in order to betray him to them... and they promised to give him money."

questions.question: How were the two disciples supposed to find the man who would provide a guest room for the Passover?
options: They were to follow a man carrying a jar of water into whatever house he enters
They were to look for a man with a red sash around his waist
They will find him waiting at the city gate holding a lamb
He will be throwing stones into the pool of Siloam
questions.correctAnswer: They were to follow a man carrying a jar of water into whatever house he enters
questions.explanation: Mark 14:13 (ESV): "And he sent two of his disciples and said to them, 'Go into the city, and a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him,'"

questions.question: As they were reclining at the table and eating the Passover, Jesus said, "Truly, I say to you, one of you will betray me, one who..."?
options: "...is eating with me."
"...has touched my garments tonight."
"...washed my feet just hours ago."
"...shares the wine from my cup alone."
questions.explanation: Mark 14:18 (ESV): "And as they were reclining at table and eating, Jesus said, 'Truly, I say to you, one of you will betray me, one who is eating with me.'"

questions.question: When Jesus took the bread, blessed, broke it, and gave it to them, what did He say?
options: "Take; this is my body."
"Eat this bread, the bread of affliction."
"This is the manna that descends from heaven."
"This represents my body which is broken."
questions.explanation: Mark 14:22 (ESV): "And as they were eating, he took bread, and after blessing it broke it and gave it to them, and said, 'Take; this is my body.'"

questions.question: What did Jesus say over the cup of wine?
options: "This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many."
"This is the new wine, meant for fresh wineskins."
"This cup is the wrath of God that passes from you."
"Drink and remember the blood painted on the doorposts."
questions.correctAnswer: "This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many."
questions.explanation: Mark 14:24 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.'"

questions.question: Jesus prophesied to Peter, "Truly, I tell you, this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me..." how many times?
options: Three times
Two times
Seven times
Twelve times
questions.explanation: Mark 14:30 (ESV): "And Jesus said to him, 'Truly, I tell you, this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.'"

questions.question: At Gethsemane, Jesus fell on the ground and prayed, crying out: "Abba, Father, all things are possible for you. Remove this cup from me. Yet..."?
options: "...not what I will, but what you will."
"...but I will bear it for their sins."
"...nevertheless your anger cannot be stayed."
"...if it must be drunk, I will drink it alone."
questions.correctAnswer: "...not what I will, but what you will."
questions.explanation: Mark 14:36 (ESV): "And he said, 'Abba, Father, all things are possible for you. Remove this cup from me. Yet not what I will, but what you will.'"

questions.question: When Jesus returned to the three disciples (Peter, James, and John) while He was praying, what did He find them doing?
options: He found them sleeping
He found them arguing about who was the greatest again
He found them weeping bitterly
He found them sharpening their swords
questions.explanation: Mark 14:37 (ESV): "And he came and found them sleeping, and he said to Peter, 'Simon, are you asleep? Could you not watch one hour?'"

questions.question: What sign did Judas give to identify Jesus to the armed crowd?
options: He came up to Jesus at once and said, "Rabbi!" and he kissed him
He pointed his staff at Jesus in the moonlight
He struck Jesus on the cheek so they would see
He gave Jesus thirty pieces of silver during the confrontation
questions.correctAnswer: He came up to Jesus at once and said, "Rabbi!" and he kissed him
questions.explanation: Mark 14:44-45 (ESV): "Now the betrayer had given them a sign, saying, 'The one I will kiss is the man.' ...he came up to him at once and said, 'Rabbi!' And he kissed him."

questions.question: What bizarre event is recorded only in Mark 14 when the disciples all left Him and fled?
options: A young man following Jesus was caught by his linen cloth, so he left the cloth and ran away naked
A woman began to wail loudly from the hillside terrifying the guards
An angel of the Lord struck three guards blind instantly
Peter hid inside a nearby tomb until morning
questions.correctAnswer: A young man following Jesus was caught by his linen cloth, so he left the cloth and ran away naked
questions.explanation: Mark 14:51-52 (ESV): "And a young man followed him, with nothing but a linen cloth about his body. And they seized him, but he left the linen cloth and ran away naked."

questions.question: Before the high priest, when asked directly, "Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?", what did Jesus boldly state?
options: "I am, and you will see the Son of Man seated at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of heaven."
"You are the one saying it, I have not spoken it."
"I am merely a prophet to the lost sheep of Israel."
"If I tell you, you will not believe."
questions.correctAnswer: "I am, and you will see the Son of Man seated at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of heaven."
questions.explanation: Mark 14:62 (ESV): "And Jesus said, 'I am, and you will see the Son of Man seated at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of heaven.'"

questions.question: After Peter denied Jesus three times, what triggered his realization that he had just done exactly what Jesus predicted?
options: And immediately the rooster crowed a second time
Jesus turned from the council window and looked at him
One of the servant girls laughed and called him Simon Peter
He saw Malchus holding his ear in pain
questions.correctAnswer: And immediately the rooster crowed a second time
questions.explanation: Mark 14:72 (ESV): "And immediately the rooster crowed a second time. And Peter remembered how Jesus had said to him, 'Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.' And he broke down and wept."

key_verse_text: And he said, "Abba, Father, all things are possible for you. Remove this cup from me. Yet not what I will, but what you will."
